parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description:
The file system ID.

- CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-0015\*\*\*\*.
> Only CPFS for Lingjun file systems are supported.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of directories to return.

Valid values: 10 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. Default value: "".

parameters.name: ParentDir
parameters.description: The parent directory path. Specifies the parent directory to query. Default value: root directory "/".
